evidence.notes: The provisional footprint uses a symmetric 0.30 m body-edge offset in all four directions because the XT16 is mounted centrally. A 5 cm body-height filter-only tolerance was selected from the 2026-06-13 stationary corridor baseline: 2-4 cm retained a symmetric rear self-return cluster at sensor-center radius 0.30-0.34 m, while 5 cm removed the cluster and 6-8 cm removed no additional points. The extra tolerance applies only at or above body_min_z_m; low hazards outside the nominal footprint remain visible. Reported clearance remains referenced to the nominal 0.30 m body edge. This estimate can under-represent the full moving envelope and must remain pending until five stationary scenes are accepted.
